definitions.explanation: An attack using artillery, cannons, or large-caliber weapons. Refers to sustained fire from heavy weapons directed at a target or area.

examples.japanese: ⟦{敵|てき}→敵：03546_teki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{砲撃|ほうげき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
⟦{市街地|しがいち}→市街地：17083_shigaichi⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{砲撃|ほうげき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{犠牲者|ぎせいしゃ}→犠牲者：18769_giseisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: The shelling of urban areas caused many casualties.

notes:
Composed of {砲|ほう} (cannon, artillery) and {撃|げき} (attack, strike). A military term frequently encountered in news coverage of armed conflicts and in historical accounts of battles.

USAGE:
Commonly appears in news reports about wars and conflicts. Also used as a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb: {砲撃|ほうげき}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to shell, to bombard).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {砲撃|ほうげき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧ — to come under shelling
- {砲撃|ほうげき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{加|くわ}える→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧ — to carry out shelling
- ⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧{砲撃|ほうげき} — fierce bombardment
- {砲撃|ほうげき}{音|おん} — sound of shelling
